text_en: See, I have called by name Bezalel son of Uri son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:
text_cn: “看，从犹大支派，我已召叫了胡尔的孙子，乌黎的儿子贝匝肋耳来，

text_en: and I have filled him with divine spirit, with ability, intelligence, and knowledge in every kind of craft,
text_cn: 以天主的神充满了他，叫他有智慧、技能和知识，能制造各种工程，

text_en: to devise artistic designs, to work in gold, silver, and bronze,
text_cn: 能设计图案，能用金、银、铜制造器物，

text_en: in cutting stones for setting, and in carving wood, in every kind of craft.
text_cn: 能雕刻宝石，镶嵌，雕刻木头，制造各种工程。

text_en: Moreover, I have appointed with him Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and I have given skill to all the skillful, so that they may make all that I have commanded you:
text_cn: 我又使丹支派阿希撒玛客的儿子敖曷里雅布与他合作；也把智慧赐给一切有艺术技能的人，好完成我吩咐你的一切：

text_en: the tent of meeting, and the ark of the covenant, and the mercy seat that is on it, and all the furnishings of the tent,
text_cn: 会幕、约柜和上面的赎罪盖及属于会幕的一切用具，

text_en: the table and its utensils, and the pure lampstand with all its utensils, and the altar of incense,
text_cn: 供桌和桌上的一切器物，纯金的灯台和灯台的一切器物和香坛，

text_en: and the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its stand,
text_cn: 全燔祭坛和一切器物，盆和盆座，

text_en: and the finely worked vestments, the holy vestments for the priest Aaron and the vestments of his sons, for their service as priests,
text_cn: 行礼的衣服，亚郎大司祭的圣衣和他儿子们行祭的服装，

text_en: and the anointing oil and the fragrant incense for the holy place. They shall do just as I have commanded you.
text_cn: 傅礼用的油和为圣所焚的香。他们应全照我吩咐你的去作。”

text_en: You yourself are to speak to the Israelites: “You shall keep my sabbaths, for this is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, given in order that you may know that I, the Lord , sanctify you.
text_cn: “你要吩咐以色列子民说：你们务要守我的安息日，这是我与你们之间世世代代的记号，使你们知道，我是祝圣你们的上主。

text_en: You shall keep the sabbath, because it is holy for you; everyone who profanes it shall be put to death; whoever does any work on it shall be cut off from among the people.
text_cn: 所以你们应守安息日，因为这日为你们是圣日，那亵渎这圣日的，应受死刑；凡在这日工作的，应从百姓中铲除。

text_en: Six days shall work be done, but the seventh day is a sabbath of solemn rest, holy to the Lord ; whoever does any work on the sabbath day shall be put to death.
text_cn: 六日中可以工作，但第七日应完全安息，因为是献于上主的圣日；凡在安息日工作的，应受死刑。

text_en: Therefore the Israelites shall keep the sabbath, observing the sabbath throughout their generations, as a perpetual covenant.
text_cn: 以色列子民要守安息日，世世代代要过安息日，作为永远的盟约。

text_en: It is a sign forever between me and the people of Israel that in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed. ”
text_cn: 这是我与以色列子民之间的永远记号，因为上主六天造了天地，第七天停工休息。”

text_en: When God finished speaking with Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two tablets of the covenant, tablets of stone, written with the finger of God.
text_cn: 上主在西乃山上向梅瑟说完了话，交给他两块约版，即天主用手指所写的石版。
